column1: # engine-features.tsv -- every SIM_FEATURE of Impure's engine (tagpu/ddraw/src/*.c, the sim files of
# thread-split.allow) and what tasim does with it, so that "tasim models the engine as Impure runs it"
# (research/notes/impai/tasim.md) stays true as simulation fixes land. tools/tasim/featcheck.py, in the DLL's
# build, refuses a feature with no row and a row naming no feature.
# tasim     modelled  the core reproduces it now (`where` names the code)
#           T1a..T1d, T2, T3, T4  the landing that models it (research/notes/impai/landings.md)
#           outside   not a rule of the simulation tasim runs: the network, the recorder and replay, saved games,
#                     the GUI and drawing, the installer (`where` says which)
# where     the core code that models it, the landing's part that will, or why it is outside
# evidence  the file the SIM_FEATURE is declared in, then what its region does, read from the region's own comment;
#           the file and never a line, which featcheck checks against the declaration (tafeat finds the line)
